caption: The drawing features a full-length dress rendered in pencil on a beige background. The main dress is shown from the front and has a fitted bodice with a high collar and long sleeves. The bodice is decorated with two symmetrical rows of buttons running vertically down the front and a pointed waistline. The skirt is wide and pleated, extending to the floor, with a stitched border near the hem. The cuffs of the sleeves have a horizontal seam and a small button detail. In the upper right, a smaller sketch shows the back of the dress, highlighting the seams and the continuation of the fitted bodice and wide skirt. The dress and all details are presented in shades of light brown and gray, with lines indicating the structure and decoration. "MAE SZILVASY" is written in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Dress
